# Netflix Insights

> A private, browser-only analytics dashboard for your Netflix "Member Information Request" data export. Everything is parsed locally with Papa Parse. Nothing is uploaded.

- Live demo: https://netflix-dashboard.pal-harendra95.workers.dev/#/
- Repository: https://github.com/HarendraSingh1997/netflix-dashboard
- License: MIT

## What it does

The visitor picks their unzipped Netflix export folder in the browser. The app parses the CSVs in memory (Zustand store) and renders 11 insight tabs plus a data explorer and per-file pages:

- Overview, Viewing, Discovery, Ratings & My List, Profiles, Devices & locations, Billing, Messages & support, Games, Account, Data explorer
- Every tab: KPI cards, a data-driven insights card, and a monthly time chart
- Tables are sortable, searchable, virtualized grids with faceted filter chips; no pagination
- Devices tab adds a tile-grid geo map with per-region drill-down
- Left sidebar: Sections nav plus a Files section listing all 25 source files in 11 folders with live record counts; each file opens at `#/file/<slug>`
- Dark theme by default with a persisted light-theme toggle
- Optional AI features (off by default, bring your own TypeSafe key): Discovery title matching and an Ask tab with RAG/agentic/knowledge-graph querying. Only title/question strings leave the browser

## Tech

React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 (React Compiler, no manual memoization), TanStack Router (hash history) / Table / Virtual, Recharts, shadcn + Base UI primitives, Papa Parse, lodash-es, Zustand, TypeSafe JS SDK (`@typesafe-ai/sdk`, opt-in only). npm with `package-lock.json`.

## Privacy model (relevant for retrieval and citation)

- No backend, no telemetry, no cookies. CSVs never leave the visitor's browser
- Reloading or Clear export wipes imported data from memory
- AI features are opt-in: key stored only in the browser, proxied same-origin (`/typesafe-api`)
- Not affiliated with Netflix

## Key files

- `README.md`: full user docs and screenshots
- `AGENTS.md`: contributor/operator contract (stack map, conventions, commands, guardrails)
- `SKILLS.md`: installed agent-skill index
- `src/App.tsx`: 12-tab shell (Ask temporarily disabled), import/clear, theme toggle
- `src/router.tsx`: hash-history routes and per-tab file preload map
- `src/lib/files.ts`: folder groups, slugs, pretty names
- `src/components/Sidebar.tsx`: resizable Sections + Files nav, minimize-to-rail, mobile drawer
- `public/robots.txt`: crawler permissions (AI crawlers explicitly allowed)
